reviewCode.recordNote: Illustrative record, not an API request.

connect.note: The source title is preserved during import.
The record moves from your file into the catalog.
Importing a feed does not grant write access to a store.

simulate.note: Keep the shopper’s request explicit so the comparison has context.
A simulated run records which listing was selected.
The result points to a stated attribute, not an assumed one.

fix.note: The title uses a fact already present in the source.
The same product facts are expressed more clearly.
The listing action leaves price and inventory alone.

track.note: The originating domain is evidence for the visit classification.
A detected referral becomes a tracking record.
A visit by itself does not establish an order or attributed revenue.

checkout.label: Checkout requirements
checkout.note: Example pseudocode. The phone requirement is relaxed; payment still uses the merchant’s gateway.

rows.note: The blocker is the required phone number the agent does not have.
No contact information is invented to pass the check.
Removing this requirement lets the sample continue to payment.
The store’s payment gateway handles payment; a buyer handoff may still be needed.
